statements.impact_statement: CVE-2024-35329 reported a heap buffer overflow in libyaml 0.2.5 in yaml_document_add_sequence() (src/api.c). The CVE has been rejected: it was withdrawn by its CNA because further investigation showed it was not a security issue (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-35329). The libyaml maintainer explained why: the proof-of-concept program never calls yaml_document_initialize() and passes a zeroed yaml_document_t to yaml_document_add_sequence(), so the overflow comes from the calling program skipping the required initialization; a program that does this cannot work at all, and libyaml's code is not at fault (https://github.com/yaml/libyaml/issues/298, https://github.com/yaml/libyaml/issues/302). The DHI libyaml packages are built from Debian's libyaml 0.2.5-2 source, which carries no Debian patches and is unmodified upstream 0.2.5, the code the maintainer reviewed.
